title: Pricing errors for one region
summary: pricing-api returned failures only for EU requests after a feature launch

logs: pricing-api ERROR missing vat_rules_v2 for region=EU
feature-client INFO flag vat-v2 enabled region=EU
deployments: vat-v2 enabled for 100% EU and 0% US at 15:10Z

runbooks.title: Scoped feature failure
runbooks.content: A region-specific regression aligned with a flag rollout should be mitigated by disabling that scope before code rollback.

oracle.root_cause: The vat-v2 flag was enabled for EU before vat_rules_v2 data was loaded.
